fusions.name: Swinging Arrival
fusions.desc: Swings you to a target up to 6 tiles away and brings both fists down on it. The blow deals 16 damage, leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second and makes it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fist-Fall Tread
fusions.desc: Each knuckled stride pounds the ground and deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Running Board
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Knuckle Gallop
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you attack 5% faster, and from gold your maximum health rises by 10.
